properties.evidence: The requirement's own words are "nested as deep as the design needs", and the closed `level` enum makes the downward half of that unsatisfiable rather than merely unpopulated: there is no value to give a part of a component, so the containment is refused by hierarchy_issues. Measured 2026-08-25 by attempting it. This is the vocabulary blocking an accepted requirement, which is different from the requirement simply being unfinished.
